title: Tate's sealed archive at University of Minnesota

tellings.quote: Long story short, we flew to Minneapolis and got a meeting at the University of Minnesota in their archives

plain: Records left by a man named John Torrance Tate, covering roughly 1948 to 1950, sit in a sealed archive at the University of Minnesota, and they bear on a story that also involves the company Texas Instruments. A researcher named Scott Ramsey, who tells it from his own search, says that "long story short, we flew to Minneapolis and got a meeting at the University of Minnesota in their archives" to see them. Ramsey raises it in a conversation about an alleged crash with alien bodies, so if true, the papers could hold early evidence of that event.
